prompt_en: Create a photorealistic commercial character-lookbook/catalog photograph inside a historic mountain hydroelectric turbine hall with a wet tiled floor, turbine housings, pressure gauges, overhead gantries, and a grated runoff channel. One unmistakably adult woman, about thirty years old, is the sole visible person, a clearly adult original character performing an ordinary upright maintenance task. Reference Image 1 supplies broad non-identifying appearance guidance: long dark softly waved hair and understated polished makeup for a new original adult character. With both feet planted and both hands engaged, she pulls down on a heavy chain hoist, visibly raising a water-beaded circular inspection hatch from the floor; the taut chain connects her hands to the mechanism as runoff spills. She wears a non-explicit revealing editorial outfit; opaque fabric visibly covers her breasts and pelvis. The outfit is revealing fantasy armor, defined by an opaque fitted plate bodice and high-waisted armored hip panel. A clearly readable fantasy armor structure is formed by rigid pauldrons, bracers, greaves, segmented plates, and mail insets. Strategic open areas between armor components keep the high-exposure design readable. Stable opaque coverage at the chest and pelvis comes from the solid bodice and hip panel. Visible straps buckles and plate connections secure each component through a readable leather-and-mail harness. Use a character lookbook presentation with a neutral eye-level full-figure catalog view showing the complete silhouette, hands, feet, armor landmarks, attachment points, and raised hatch together. A diagonal chain links gantry, hands, and hatch; even industrial side light reveals solid surfaces, fasteners, wet tile, runoff, and mist. Her weight stays evenly planted and her gaze stays on the mechanism, making ordinary work effort the first read.
